text:
Lena: Heads-up  procurement shortlisted InvoiceX and MatchMate for our reconciliation rewrite. Need quick clarity on unit pricing, committed discounts, price-lock windows, and exit/egress fees before RFP final.

Tom: InvoiceX quoted $0.025/invoice, but they offer a 20% discount if we commit to 500k/yr. MatchMate quoted $0.018/invoice with a 12-mo minimum and a $4k onboarding fee.

Ravi: Two operational asks: (1) do either provide a signed SLA for p99 lookup latency? (2) what are export/egress formats and fees on termination?

procurement: @vendor-sam can you confirm InvoiceX policy on price increases and whether price-lock for 12 months is possible? Also what the data export looks like at termination.

vendor-sam: Hi all  InvoiceX can commit to a 12-month price lock at the quoted tier if we sign a 12-mo MSA. Data export: full NDJSON export of raw invoices + attachments (if stored) within 30 days. No egress fee for standard exports; DB snapshots are a paid service ($1k).

Finance-bot: Reminder: any multi-year commit needs FP review and VP sign-off if >$50k ARR.

Tom: MatchMate's rep mentioned quarterly price indexing tied to CPI. That's a red flag for us. Can Legal advise on acceptable escalation clauses?

Legal: CPI indexing ok with cap (we usually ask for cap at 3%/yr). Also require a material change clause and right to terminate for significant price hikes.

Ravi: For onboarding: which vendor gives trial credits or free migration support? That affects first-year TCO heavily.

vendor-sam: We can offer a $3k migration credit for pilots if you sign a pilot SOW. For long-term deals we can include 5k in professional-services credit on a 12-mo commit.

procurement: MatchMate, any trial credits?

vendor-match: (via DM posted) We can provide 2 weeks free ingestion for up to 25k invoices and reduced onboarding to $1,500 if you commit within 30 days. No public post here per their request.

Eng: Need to know connector patterns. Do both vendors support SuiteTalk/Netsuite, QuickBooks Online, and SFTP agent? Also whether they accept gzipped CSV/NDJSON and incremental delta imports.

vendor-sam: InvoiceX supports SuiteTalk, QBO, SFTP agent, gzipped CSV/NDJSON, and incremental imports via POST /v1/imports/delta. SSH agent available for air-gapped setups (Enterprise).

procurement: Any clauses about audit logs retention and access? We need 12 months of immutable logs per compliance.

vendor-sam: We retain ingestion logs 12 months by default; audit export available as NDJSON. Enterprise can extend retention.

Legal: Also want BYOK/KMS integration for EU tenants and an explicit DPA. Make sure vendor provides SOC2 Type II report.

vendor-sam: BYOK via AWS KMS or GCP KMS available on Enterprise. SOC2 Type II available; will share attestation after NDA.

Finance-bot: Napkin calc: if we do 500k/yr commit at InvoiceX discounted 20% -> $0.02/invoice => $10k/yr plus credits/fees. MatchMate at $0.018 => $9k/yr but with onboarding and potential CPI risk. Include migration credits and one-time fees in comparative TCO.

procurement: Proposed next step: run 10-day pilots with both vendors (InvoiceX pilot with migration credit applied; MatchMate pilot with 25k free ingestion). Evaluate: integration hours, delta dedupe FP rate, p95/p99 latencies, and service responsiveness. Procurement will draft short pilot SOWs aiming to keep one-time spend under manager approval thresholds.

Lena: I'll own InvoiceX pilot. Tom will own MatchMate. Eng to provide test harness and sample dataset (50k rows). Legal to prepare pilot SOW template with price-lock & CPI cap language.

vendor-sam: I'll DM sandbox creds and a sample mapping CSV. Happy to increase rate limits for pilot window.

Tom: MatchMate DM'd sandbox as well, starting tests tomorrow.

Lena: Great. Please capture POC results in the vendor scorecard doc. Re-open if contract negotiation items require broader review. :white_check_mark:
